messages:
Maya: Quick sync — working on the PRD for Console observability (dashboards, tracing, retention). Need to lock scope + launch criteria by EOW. Thoughts?
Ben: Agree. Biggest open: retention tiers vs cost. Do we want default 30d, optional 90d, and an audit 365d? What's the minimum for customer use-cases?
Alex: 30d default is fine for most UX flows. Acceptance criteria I propose:
- Dashboards show per-route latency + 99th percentile
- Traces can be sampled and linked to request ids
- Retention configurable by org and route
- Alerts for OOMs / tail latency regressions
Sophia: Important: legal/reg customers will require >1y audit logs. We should support export to S3 as part of launch. Also need sampling knobs to avoid spikes in storage.
Ben: +1 on S3 export. Also need rollout plan: beta for Dedicated + Private first? Hosted only if we have cost controls in place.
Maya: For scope negotiation, here's what I think we can do for M1 (launch):
- M1 core: dashboards for routes + tasks, 30d retention, trace sampling (1%), exports to S3 for audit only
- M2: per-team configurable retention UI, long-term audit retention UI (365d), advanced query
- M3: retention tiers billing, continuous sampling adjustments, region-level retention
Alex: Example config snippet for retention in config UI (for acceptance tests):
```
retention:
  default_days: 30
  audit_days: 365
  sampling_rate: 0.01
```
Ben: Acceptance criteria for rollout:
- Performance: A 50% increase in ingestion load must keep  p50/p99 within SLOs for 95% of tenants during canary
- Cost: estimate for hosted customers should be <10% increase in infra cost per 10k requests/day
- UX: basic filtering + timeframe selection present
Sophia: Edge cases:
- Burst traffic causing sampling to drop traces -> need backpressure + dropping policy
- Encrypted logs retention + KMS rotation for Private -> docs + tests
- Cross-region linking: request ids might be stripped by proxies
Maya: Launch checklist (short):
- PRD signoff (this thread)
- Design screens finalized
- Open-source demo + docs
- Beta internal test + 2 external customers
- Rollout runbook and rollback plan
Alex: UX flow note: filter remembers last 2 filters per user, preset quick views for latency / error / cost
Ben: Prioritization ask: If we have to cut scope, defer per-route retention UI and advanced billing; keep S3 export + basic UI + trace linking
Maya: Sounds good. Any objections? If none, I'll convert this into a PRD doc and add acceptance criteria table, then request signoffs.
Sophia: No objections from SRE. I'll add ops runbook and sampling safeguards.
DeployBot: Note: created PRD draft -> link: https://redwood.internal/docs/console-observability-prd-draft
Ben: FYI I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to review acceptance tests :calendar:
Maya: Thanks everyone — I'll draft PRD and ping for signoff before EOD Friday :thumbsup:
